incidents.title: HDFC Bank UPI Authorization Degradation
incidents.root_cause: HDFC UPI partner gateway timeouts detected. Direct retries failing at 84%.
incidents.recommended_approach: Suppress same-rail retries; dispatch alternate method payment link via WhatsApp.

incidents.title: ICICI Card 3DS Authentication Timeout

incidents.recommended_approach: Bypass 3DS retry; dispatch instant UPI QR 1-click payment link.

incidents.title: SBI AutoPay e-Mandate Balance Deficit

incidents.recommended_approach: Schedule e-mandate retry window on salary cycle day (1st-3rd of month).
